about_the_game:
"Less pretty, more witty. The civilization economics simulator for players who think."

CivEconomy: From Bronze to Iron

Experience the Bronze Age like never before - where every family's story shapes your civilization.

A Living, Breathing Economy

In CivEconomy, your civilization isn't just numbers on a screen. Every family is an independent economic agent with their own production, consumption, and dreams of prosperity. Watch as the Ishtar family grows from humble farmers to successful pottery merchants, while the Marduk clan struggles through a harsh winter, rationing their dwindling food supplies.

Key Features

🏺 __Family-Driven Economy__

- Each family produces, trades, and manages their own resources

- Success breeds success - thriving families grow and split into new households

- Economic specialization creates real risk and reward

- Natural population dynamics based on actual food availability

🌾 __Meaningful Specialization__

- Over 20 unique specializations from farming to bronze smithing

- Families must successfully trade their goods for food or face starvation

- Technology unlocks new opportunities - pottery wheels enable potters, copper smelting creates miners

- Every specialization decision impacts your civilization's development

🏛️ __Deep City Management__

- Design cities hex by hex based on terrain and resources

- Clay gathering by rivers, mining in mountains, salt harvesting on coasts

- Cities grow organically as successful families expand

- Visual progression from small settlements to thriving Bronze Age towns

⚔️ __Strategic Combat__

- Your citizens become militia to defend their homes

- Tactical battles utilize city layout and terrain advantages

- Every soldier lost is a worker gone

- Progress from wooden clubs to bronze weapons as technology advances

📊 __Economic Simulation__

- Real supply and demand drives your internal markets

- Seasonal variations affect production and consumption

- Food spoilage and stockpile management

- Trade networks emerge naturally from family needs

🎭 __Emergent Storytelling__

- Follow individual families through generations

- Economic success and failure create natural narratives

- Watch dynasties rise and fall based on their choices

- Every game tells a different story

Why CivEconomy?

Unlike traditional strategy games, CivEconomy simulates a real Bronze Age economy where:

- There's no magical food distribution - families must produce or trade to survive

- Demographics matter - elderly farmers produce less than young adults

- Market failures have real consequences

- Success comes from understanding and managing complex economic relationships

### Perfect For:

- Strategy enthusiasts who want deeper economic gameplay

- History lovers interested in authentic Bronze Age challenges

- Players who enjoy emergent storytelling and unique narratives

- Anyone seeking a fresh take on civilization building

__Build a civilization where every family matters, every harvest counts, and every decision shapes the future.__

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or equivalent modern distribution
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel Core i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: X11 with compatible window manager
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent (or Apple Silicon with Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
